name: Waste Management
description: WM is North America's largest waste company: it collects trash from homes, businesses and factories, moves it through 342 transfer stations (excluding Stericycle's), and dumps it in the largest landfill network in the US and Canada (257 sites). The money is in vertical integration: it collects waste, then sends it to its own landfills, and third-party haulers also pay to dump at WM landfills because landfills are hard to permit and build. Collection and Disposal (East and West tiers plus ancillary) was 82% of 2025 revenue and 100% of segment profit; the rest is recycling, renewable energy (landfill gas turned into pipeline gas and power) and Healthcare Solutions (medical and regulated waste, from the Stericycle purchase in late 2024), which was a $88M operating loss in 2025. Pricing runs about 3-4% a year on the core: collection and disposal average yield +3.8% in 2025.

hq.note: FY2025 10-K cover; services in the US and Canada

employees.note: About 60,500 full-time employees: 53,600 US and 6,900 outside the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Collection and Disposal - East Tier
businessLines.how: Recurring fees from commercial, industrial and residential customers billed monthly or by pickup, often under multi-year municipal contracts, plus landfill tipping fees; pricing above inflation and integrated disposal drive margin.
businessLines.description: Collection, transfer and landfill disposal in the Eastern US, Great Lakes and substantially all of Canada.

operatingProfit.note: segment income from operations before Corporate and Other (-$1,436M); share computed against the $5,744M sum of the reportable segments and other ancillary

businessLines.name: Collection and Disposal - West Tier
businessLines.how: Same model as East Tier; higher landfill and leachate cost noted in 2025.
businessLines.description: Collection, transfer and landfill disposal in the Western US and Pacific/Mountain regions.

operatingProfit.note: segment income from operations before Corporate and Other (-$1,436M); share computed against the $5,744M sum of the reportable segments and other ancillary

businessLines.name: Other Ancillary (Collection and Disposal)
businessLines.how: Fees for supporting services; roughly break-even.
businessLines.description: Ancillary services not run through the tiers that support collection and disposal.

operatingProfit.note: segment income from operations before Corporate and Other (-$1,436M); share computed against the $5,744M sum of the reportable segments and other ancillary

businessLines.name: Recycling Processing and Sales
businessLines.how: Sells sorted commodities at market prices plus processing fees; hit by weak commodity pricing and demand (plastic film and wrap) in 2025.
businessLines.description: Sorting and selling recyclable commodities (paper, plastics, metals) and organics.

operatingProfit.note: segment income from operations before Corporate and Other (-$1,436M); share computed against the $5,744M sum of the reportable segments and other ancillary

businessLines.name: Renewable Energy
businessLines.how: Sells RNG and power (and credits) produced from landfill gas WM already collects; profit tracks gas and environmental-credit prices.
businessLines.description: Landfill gas converted to renewable natural gas and electricity.

operatingProfit.note: segment income from operations before Corporate and Other (-$1,436M); share computed against the $5,744M sum of the reportable segments and other ancillary

businessLines.name: Healthcare Solutions (Stericycle)
businessLines.how: Recurring per-pickup service fees to hospitals, clinics and businesses; integration and margin still below plan (operating loss).
businessLines.description: Medical and regulated waste, secure information destruction and compliance services, acquired with Stericycle in November 2024.
